provenance: Approved direct batch-six integration 2026-10-29. Original Arknights media; open redistribution permission unconfirmed. PNG bytes retained; uniform 1.25-unit idle height and foot-center pivot.

sourcePointEvidence.frameContract: Use exact displayed body sprite key/frame, original per-clip PPU, pixelScale and originX/Y. No independent clock or PNG re-render. Existing point tracks/bindings/scale flags are preserved byte-value-for-value.
sourcePointEvidence.staticPointContract: Static Transform relative to source SkeletonAnimation transform, position divided by source SkeletonDataAsset.scale to match original Spine raw units; bone="[static Transform]" is an explicit non-bone marker. sourceDepth uses the same raw-unit scale and is not silently applied as world height.
sourcePointEvidence.logicalAnchors: Foot and Ground require caller entity/map terrain anchors; NONE preserves caller point. No synthesized Foot/Ground bone, no source-null point fallback.
